name: Nuño Gómez (Spain)
description: Vertically divided yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Nuño Gómez (a tree on white and the bars of Aragon).
history: Municipal flag of Nuño Gómez; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Nuño Gómez arms — tree on white and the bars of Aragon within a border
bars and crown of the arms
